entries.summary: The gate failed: CI failed or did not run, or the leak scan found something.
entries.what_to_do: Fix the feature (code, tests or leaked content) and gate again. Never try to work around the leak scan.

entries.summary: CI failed on the gate candidate.
entries.what_to_do: Fix the failing checks listed in details.failed, push to the feature branch, and gate again.

entries.summary: CI did not finish in time.
entries.what_to_do: Gate again, or raise gate.ci_timeout in .ghostbranch.yml.

entries.summary: The leak scan found something in what would be published.
entries.what_to_do: Remove the content in details.findings from the feature and gate again. A finding whose commits are listed may be only in older commits: publish with --mode squash or --mode curated so they never ship, or rewrite those commits on the feature branch, force-push it to the shadow repo, and gate again. If a person judges a finding in details.waivable a false positive, they run the waivers add command in next. Agents never waive findings or edit waivers.json.

entries.summary: A file has BEGIN-INTERNAL/END-INTERNAL markers that cannot be stripped safely.
causes: unmatched_begin: a begin marker with no end
unmatched_end: an end marker with no begin
nested: a begin marker inside an open section
malformed: a line that looks like a marker but is not exactly one (more text, a doubled prefix, or a multi-line comment)
unsupported_encoding: markers in a UTF-16 or UTF-32 file, or in a file read as binary
entries.what_to_do: Fix the marker lines at details.problems on the feature branch, push it to the shadow repo, and gate again. When details.commit names an older commit and the final tree no longer has the problem, publish with --mode squash or --mode curated so it never ships, or rewrite that commit on the feature branch and force-push it to the shadow repo. Never delete only the marker lines: the internal lines would then be published.

entries.summary: No CI checks appeared on the gate candidate.
causes: Actions is disabled in the shadow repo
no workflow triggers on pull_request or push
entries.what_to_do: Enable Actions or add a workflow, then gate again.
